data.name: Ibraheemah
data.gender_notes: Ibraheemah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and loyalty to the Prophet Ibrahim (AS). The name Ibraheemah carries the meaning “Servant of Abraham” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibraheemah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of abraham and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To follow the path of righteousness and demonstrate selfless service.
data.etymology: Ibraheemah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Abraham.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibraheemah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيمة
in_arabic.meaning: إبراهيمة تعني الأم التي تربي الأولاد بالحب والحنان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إبراهيمة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من اسم إبراهيم عليه السلام، ويعني الأم التي تربي الأولاد بالحب والحنان، والمرأة التي تتسم بالرحمة والتعاطف مع الآخرين. ورد ذكر اسم إبراهيم في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، منها سورة البقرة وسورة آل عمران وسورة النمل.

in_urdu.name: ابراہیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: ابراہیمہ یعنی ماں جو اولاد کو محبت اور شفقت سے پالتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیمہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کے نام سے مشتق ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ماں جو اولاد کو محبت اور شفقت سے پالتی ہے، یا وہ عورت جو رحمت اور دوسروں کے ساتھ ہمدردی کا اظہار کرتی ہے۔ ابراہیم کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں کئی سورتوں میں کیا گیا ہے، جن میں سورہ البقرة، سورہ آل عمران اور سورہ النمل شامل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इब्राहिमा
in_hindi.meaning: इब्राहिमा का अर्थ है माँ जो बच्चों को प्यार और दया से पालती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्राहिमा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। यह नाम हज़रत इब्राहिम अलैहिस्सलाम के नाम से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है माँ जो बच्चों को प्यार और दया से पालती है, या वह महिला जो दयालुता और दूसरों के साथ सहानुभूति प्रकट करती है। इब्राहिम का उल्लेख कुरआन में कई सूरतों में किया गया है, जिनमें सूरह अल-बक़राह, सूरह आल इम्रान और सूरह अन-नम्ल शामिल हैं।

in_pashto.name: إبراهيمه
in_pashto.meaning: إبراهيمه د مورنۍ په معنى ده چې ماشومان يې په مينه او شفقت پالي
in_pashto.long_meaning: إبراهيمه يو مؤنث نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا نوم د حضرت ابراهيم عليه السلام د نوم څخه مشتق شوی دی. دا د مورنۍ په معنى ده چې ماشومان يې په مينه او شفقت پالي، يا هغه ښځه چې د رحمت او نورو سره د همدردۍ څرګندونه کوي. ابراهيم په قرآن کريم کې په ډېرو سورتونو کې ياد شوی دی، په شمول سوره البقره، سوره آل عمران او سوره النمل.

in_english.name: Ibraheemah
in_english.meaning: Ibraheemah means a loving mother or a compassionate woman
in_english.long_meaning: Ibraheemah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic name Ibraheem, which means 'father of many nations.' The name Ibraheemah signifies a loving mother or a compassionate woman. It is rooted in the Arabic language and is associated with the biblical and Quranic figure of Abraham. The name conveys qualities of nurturing, care, and kindness. In Islamic tradition, Ibraheemah is considered a name that embodies the values of compassion, empathy, and motherly love.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibraheemah holds significant cultural value in the Islamic world as it is the Arabic translation of the biblical Abraham. Prophet Ibrahim (AS) is revered as a father figure in Islam, and his strong faith, unwavering devotion to Allah, and absolute obedience to the divine command have inspired countless generations. Naming a child Ibraheemah is a way to pay tribute to this great prophet and his unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ibraheemah holds immense spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is believed that the person bearing this name will be reminded of the virtues and characteristics of Prophet Ibrahim (AS), namely devotion, obedience, and unwavering faith. The name Ibraheemah conjures up images of steadfastness, sacrifice, and submission to Allah's will. It serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to strive for excellence in character and deeds, and to emulate the heroic deeds of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant of Abraham" symbolizes A name that signifies devotion and loyalty to the Prophet Ibrahim (AS).. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ibraheemah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant of abraham.
